# The physics library: Jolt behind a small C interface (include/blitzphysics.h). Jolt is built into it, so nothing else needs to
# know of Jolt, and the C interface is what is the same across compilers and platforms.
if(NOT EXISTS "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/JoltPhysics/Build/CMakeLists.txt")
	message(FATAL_ERROR "The submodule 'third_party/JoltPhysics' is missing, run 'git submodule update --init' first.")
endif()

# Jolt, as a static library of this library. The same results on every compiler and CPU, no RTTI (as the library), and the
# baseline of the instruction sets: the library is one file for all CPUs of an architecture.
set(CROSS_PLATFORM_DETERMINISTIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPP_RTTI_ENABLED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_STATIC_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_OBJECT_STREAM OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_ALL_WARNINGS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DOUBLE_PRECISION OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GENERATE_DEBUG_SYMBOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OVERRIDE_CXX_FLAGS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
# Jolt's hair simulation runs on compute shaders, which are compiled with glslc and dxc (and Metal tools) at build time. Nothing here
# simulates hair, so none of the compute back ends are built.
foreach(_OPTION IN ITEMS JPH_USE_DX12 JPH_USE_VK JPH_USE_MTL JPH_USE_CPU_COMPUTE)
	set(${_OPTION} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endforeach()
foreach(_OPTION IN ITEMS TARGET_UNIT_TESTS TARGET_HELLO_WORLD TARGET_PERFORMANCE_TEST TARGET_SAMPLES TARGET_VIEWER USE_SSE4_1 USE_SSE4_2 USE_AVX USE_AVX2 USE_AVX512 USE_LZCNT USE_TZCNT USE_F16C USE_FMADD)
	set(${_OPTION} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endforeach()
add_subdirectory("${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/JoltPhysics/Build" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/jolt" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

set_target_properties(Jolt PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

add_library(blitzphysics SHARED)
init_project(blitzphysics)
target_sources(blitzphysics PRIVATE
	"include/blitzphysics.h"
	"source/blitzphysics.cpp"
	"source/common.cpp"
	"source/common.hpp"
	"source/simulation.cpp"
)
target_include_directories(blitzphysics PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
target_compile_definitions(blitzphysics PRIVATE BLITZPHYSICS_BUILD)
target_link_libraries(blitzphysics PRIVATE Jolt)
set_target_properties(blitzphysics PROPERTIES
	CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
	VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON
	# The library is found next to the programs that use it.
	BUILD_RPATH "\$ORIGIN"
)
if(NOT WIN32)
	# libblitzphysics.so and libblitzphysics.dylib, as shared libraries are named there.
	set_target_properties(blitzphysics PROPERTIES PREFIX "lib")
endif()
if(MSVC)
	target_compile_options(blitzphysics PRIVATE /GR- /EHs-c-)
else()
	target_compile_options(blitzphysics PRIVATE -fno-rtti)
endif()
if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
	target_link_options(blitzphysics PRIVATE -Wl,--exclude-libs,ALL)
endif()

get_target_property(_SOURCES blitzphysics SOURCES)
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${_SOURCES})
